name: cmd_photo_setRegion
description: Resize Face Box (command `photo.setRegion`). Params: {id?, index, rect: {x0, y0, x1, y1}} — set one face / pet region's box (normalized, in the photo's upright frame; clamped to the photo, at least 0.5 % each way) in the catalog; undoable. Like photo.removeRegion it never rewrites the XMP sidecar.
